post_install: python -m pip install pytest pytest-cov pytest-gitconfig pytest-xdist pexpect inline-snapshot plumbum poethepoet

notes: The project declares test dependencies in dependency-groups rather than package extras, so install pytest-gitconfig, xdist, pexpect, inline-snapshot, plumbum, and poethepoet explicitly.
Stage 2 container bundles install from git archives without .git metadata; set pretend version variables so hatch-vcs/setuptools-scm version resolution remains stable.
Selected candidates exercise git checkout/update behavior, so container probes need the git executable available.
